title: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme
description: Provides financial assistance to startups for proof of concept, prototype development, product trials, market-entry and commercialisation.
eligibility: DPIIT-recognised startups up to 2 years old
ai_summary: A government seed fund offering up to ₹20L for early-stage DPIIT-recognised startups to develop prototypes and enter market.

title: BIRAC SPARSH Fellowship 2025
description: Fellowship supporting early-stage biotech innovators with funding and mentorship from leading research institutions.
ai_summary: BIRAC SPARSH offers ₹30L fellowship for biotech innovators with institutional mentorship.

title: Kerala Startup Mission Innovation Challenge
description: KSUM invites applications from Kerala-based startups in CleanTech, AgriTech and HealthTech sectors for its annual innovation challenge.
eligibility: Kerala-registered startups less than 5 years old
ai_summary: KSUM annual challenge with ₹10L prize for CleanTech, AgriTech and HealthTech startups registered in Kerala.

title: DST NIDHI Accelerator Programme
description: National Initiative for Developing and Harnessing Innovations — accelerator support including funding, mentorship, IP support and global market access.
ai_summary: DST NIDHI accelerates deep-tech startups with up to ₹50L funding, IP support and global market access.

title: Tata Trusts CSR Innovation Grant
description: Tata Trusts invites proposals from social enterprises and NGOs working in rural health, education and livelihood sectors for CSR funding support.
eligibility: Registered NGOs and social enterprises in India
ai_summary: Tata Trusts CSR grant of ₹25L for rural-focused social enterprises in health, education and livelihoods.

title: IIM Ahmedabad CIIE.CO Incubation Call
description: CIIE.CO at IIM Ahmedabad invites applications from early-stage startups for its flagship incubation programme with office space, mentorship and investor access.
eligibility: Pre-seed to Series A startups across sectors
ai_summary: IIM-A CIIE flagship incubation with office, mentors and investor network for pre-seed to Series A startups.
